newsitem.title: UK: BAe, Rolls ask for end of golden shares-paper.
newsitem.headline: BAe, Rolls ask for end of golden shares-paper.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc and Rolls-Royce Plc have asked the British government to change the "golden shares" arrangements, which restrict foreign ownership in the companies to 29.5 percent, the Observer newspaper reported on Sunday.
Both companies believe the 29.5 percent ceiling holds back their share prices and limits strategic expansion plans.
Britain's Labour government last week relinquished its golden share in British Telecommunications Plc, encouraging British Aerospace and Rolls-Royce to renew their request.
Both companies earlier failed to persuade the former Conservative government, which was defeated by Labour in May's election, to change the golden share arrangements, the Observer said.
The newspaper cited a spokesman for the Department of Trade and Industry as saying that the issue was currently being studied, but that a decision was not likely for a few months.
